patterns.note: A grid-like arrangement of full-width, distinctively colored blocks, each showcasing a different font family with its name in white text.
Extreme variation in display typography, with each font example presented in an oversized, bold, and unique style, contrasting with small, understated sans-serif UI text.
Use of highly saturated, often primary or secondary, distinct background colors for each font example block, creating a vibrant and energetic visual rhythm.
The initial hero text disappears on scroll, replaced by a transforming sticky header and a large, stylized graphic element that reveals as the user scrolls down.
Dedicated sections for 'Custom Fonts' and 'In Use' feature image-based examples, breaking the grid of color blocks with more editorial content.

technique_notes: Sections reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport, likely orchestrated by a scroll-triggering library like GSAP to create a dynamic content flow.
The initial hero content transitions out upon scrolling, and a new, more detailed sticky header appears, along with a large, illustrative graphic that animates into view.
Full-width, distinctively colored blocks are used to visually separate and highlight individual font families, acting as interactive cards within the content stream.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, and varied display headings (up to ~10x body) with small, understated sans-serif body text and labels, emphasizing the unique character of each font.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, with no visible rounded elements, contributing to a clean and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing within content blocks, but very airy between major sections, especially the initial hero and the large font examples, creating a sense of spaciousness.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its unapologetic and playful celebration of diverse, bold typography, using each font as a primary visual element within a vibrant, full-width color block grid. The dynamic hero transition and scroll-triggered reveals add to its artistic and experimental feel, making it a living portfolio of type.
